input: read ./prompt.md and follow the instructions there
task: Deepen flagship photo-editing (allocate.py row 6): DNG-spec colour model in the developer
errors: Robertson-CCT fixed-point iteration capped at 30 steps left the white 0.0015 off on 37/400 random profiles; caught by the colour-hdri differential and fixed (iterate on blend weight, bisect when stalled).
A bisection-only white finder picked a different self-consistent white on multi-root profiles; fixed by iterating first.
A [0.1, 10] Bradford cone-ratio guard diverged from the spec near 2,000 K; removed.
colour-hdri's camera_neutral_to_xy has no step limit and hung the first 2,000-case run; the tool now gives it 2 s per case.
First post front matter: description 212 and then 163 chars (limit 160) made venture-preflight's build fail; trimmed.

doc_friction.issue: Two suite failures are environmental in the cloud container: test_real_photo_calibration needs a working PIL (system PIL lacks _imaging), test_workspace_health's unreadable-file test passes the file as readable when run as root. Not caused by this change; worth a skip guard.
The hook rejects pkill/pgrep -f patterns that also appear elsewhere in the same command line, even when bracketed; had to split into separate calls.

goal: Deepen the photo-editing flagship with a hard engineering slice (colour science) verified against an independent implementation and a real camera profile.
notes: New src/shootflow/dng_colour.py (DNG spec ch.6: Robertson CCT, mired blending of ColorMatrix/CameraCalibration/ForwardMatrix, AnalogBalance, AsShotWhiteXY, Bradford to D50 and on to sRGB D65); default colour='dng', --colour dcraw keeps the LibRaw model (libraw_differential now asks for it). Verification: tests/test_dng_colour.py 15 tests + 18 existing developer tests, test_ffmpeg_pipeline and test_cli pass (120 tests); numpy engine parity tests pass in a venv. tools/dng_colour_check.py vs colour-hdri 0.2.6, 2,000 cases seed 1: matrices agree to 8.5e-14, CCT to 1.8e-12 K; 2 multi-root profiles settle on different whites. Real Canon 350D DNG tags (exiftool test image, not committed): white 0.4014/0.3905, 3584 K, equal to colour-hdri within 2e-15; dcraw vs dng up to 35.5 (mean 9.1) 8-bit steps on 64 patches. Full photo-editing unittest discover: 576 tests, 2 environmental failures (PIL, root). venture-preflight: rerun after post front-matter fix (see PR).
